wave.summary:
Fixed all 4 look-pass chart edge cases within the strict file scope (no tokens.css/contract/fixtures/package.json touched).

1. Sparkline.tsx: the end-value reading was hard-anchored at (WIDTH, HEIGHT-1) unconditionally. Now anchors relative to the final point's y — reading goes near the top (y=PAD+5=7) when the line ends in the chart's upper half (high reading, where a rising line's final approach previously struck through the fixed bottom-anchored numerals), and keeps the original bottom anchor (y=HEIGHT-1=17) when the line ends low. Added a test with a monotonically-rising series (final point at the chart top, cy=2) asserting the reading moved off the old fixed y=17 and sits with a >=4-unit clear gap from the dot.

2. Heatmap.tsx (month labels): confirmed via code inspection and targeted tests that the 53-week window/month-label derivation was already structurally independent of `commitDays` (it only depends on `endDayKey`), so an empty activity map with a valid, explicit endDayKey already produces strictly-increasing, non-overlapping month-label x positions. Added a regression test anchored at a Dec/Jan boundary (endDayKey="2026-01-04") asserting strictly increasing x and >= one-column-width gaps between all labels, locking in this behavior.

3. Heatmap.tsx (future days): the real bug — cells strictly after `endDayKey` (i.e. within the final week's remaining days) rendered as normal observed "0 commits" cells with full aria-labels regardless of whether the snapshot day was actually reached. Fixed by computing `isFuture = hasKnownEnd && key > endDayKey` per cell and omitting the `<rect>` entirely for future cells (only when endDayKey is valid — the deterministic epoch fallback for missing/invalid endDayKey keeps rendering the full 371-cell rectangle unchanged, since there's no real "future" to exclude, preserving the existing "renders safely on empty data" test). Added tests verifying a Tuesday endDayKey correctly omits the trailing Wed-Sat future cells (371-4=367 cells) with no future dayKey rendering any element at all, plus a control test confirming the invalid-endDayKey fallback still renders the full rectangle.

4. Strata.tsx: empty `loc` previously rendered one large low-opacity rect (reads as broken). Now renders an explicit "No lines surveyed." text message, reusing the existing `.chart-timeline__empty-label` class from charts.css (no new CSS needed, staying in scope) for the same muted-ink styling Timeline's own empty state uses. Updated the pre-existing "renders safely on empty loc" test's stale assertion (which encoded the old buggy 1-band behavior) to assert zero bands and the new message text, per the conductor's explicit note that this test needed extending to match the fixed behavior.

Full suite: 177 tests passed across 9 files (up from prior baseline of 173 — 4 new/extended chart tests), with every pre-existing Heatmap/Timeline/Sparkline test (all the hand-computed fixture-driven ones) still green and unmodified except the one Strata assertion the acceptance criteria explicitly directed to update.

wave.summary:
Built src/components/CommandPalette.tsx as a self-contained component: exports `CommandPalette` (props: repos: RepoSummary[] {id,name,path}, open, onClose, onNavigate) and the `useCommandPalette()` hook, which owns the global Cmd+K/Ctrl+K keydown listener and returns {open, setOpen}. Fuzzy matching is a dependency-free subsequence scorer (`fuzzyScore`/`rankRepos`, both exported) over "name path", rewarding early/consecutive-run matches; empty query falls back to full name-sorted list. ArrowUp/Down moves the active row, Enter fires onNavigate(repo.id) + onClose, Escape closes without navigating, clicking the backdrop closes without navigating, clicking a row navigates, and the search input carries autoFocus (the component unmounts fully while closed, so a fresh mount is exactly when autoFocus fires).

Styling is fully self-contained via an inline `<style>` block built only from tokens.css custom properties (color/space/type — no bespoke values), using the frozen contract's CSS.plate / CSS.palette / CSS.gazetteerRow / CSS.sounding render-vocabulary classes as the base and extending them with `palette-cmdk__*` modifier classes, since src/styles/* is frozen/out of scope for this item and no new stylesheet file could be added.

Documented the exact two-line App.tsx wiring both in a header comment at the top of CommandPalette.tsx and in src/components/paletteWiring.md (App.tsx itself was not touched — it's out of scope/owned by another item; the conductor applies the wiring).

CommandPalette.test.tsx (14 tests): fuzzyScore/rankRepos unit tests; a mounted host component exercising the exported useCommandPalette hook (Cmd+K opens, Ctrl+K also opens, second press toggles closed — mandatory hook-mount test); typing 'swm' narrows to only the swarm-ish fixture repo; Enter navigates to the top/selected match id and closes; ArrowDown then Enter picks the next row; Escape closes without navigating; backdrop click closes without navigating; row click navigates; autofocus on open.

Symlinked the main repo's node_modules into the worktree (untracked, per instructions) before running `npm test`; only the three in-scope files were git-added and committed (the node_modules symlink was left untracked, matching the .gitignore intent for node_modules even though a symlink doesn't match the `node_modules/`-suffixed gitignore pattern literally).
